(To be Published in the Gazette of India Extraordinary Part-II, Section - 3, Sub-Section (ii))
Government of India
Ministry of Commerce & Industry
Department of Commerce
Directorate General of Foreign Trade
Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi
Notification No. #5 /2023
New Delhi, Dated: 14" March, 2024
Subject: - Imposition of Minimum Export Price (MEP) on export of Honey.
S.O. (E) In exercise of powers conferred by Section 3 read with section 5 of the Foreign Trade
(Development & Regulation) Act, 1992 (No. 22 of 1992), as amended, read with Para 1.02 and
2.01 of the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023, the Central Government hereby imposes Minimum
Export Price (MEP) on export of Natural Honey under ITC HS code 0409 00 00 of Schedule 2 of
the ITC (HS) Export Policy, 2023, as under: -
Tariff item Item description | Export Policy ; ‘Policy condition os
HS Code a .
0409 0000 | Natural Honey | Free Subject to a Minimum Export Price (MEP)
| of US $ 2000 per Metric Ton (PMT), till 31
| December, 2024 or until further orders,
ee whichever is earlier.”
2: The Notification will come into immediate effect. Transitional arrangements under Para
1.05 of Foreign Trade Policy, 2023 will be applicable.
3 Effect of this Notification:
Export of Natural Honey is ‘Free’. Minimum Export Price (MEP) of US $ 2000 per Metric Ton
(PMT) is imposed till 31 December, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.”
